name: Channel and wholesale sales manager
summary: Wins and keeps the shops, distributors, resellers and partners who sell for the business. Sets terms and margins that work for both sides.

changelog.note: First release: 23 checked sources (FTC, DOJ and CMA guidance and cases on resale prices, Robinson-Patman, EU vertical rules, HubSpot, Xero, Microsoft and AWS partner programmes, Shopify B2B, partner disclosure, late payment), four skills, six prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs, with access levels 1 to 3.
